title: Operational runbooks for failover and cluster recovery

spec.title: Operational runbooks for failover and cluster recovery
spec.lead: Pre-scripted T-SQL and PowerShell procedures eliminate manual guesswork during regional disasters and maintenance.
spec.notes:
Industry benchmarks identify human error and configuration drift during manual failover runbooks as a primary driver of prolonged disaster recovery outages. When promoting an asynchronous secondary replica in Region 2 during a regional disaster, manual forced failover (FORCE_FAILOVER_ALLOW_DATA_LOSS) is required.

Sources:
[2] Deploying Microsoft SQL Server for Multi-Regional Disaster Recovery (Google Cloud, 2024) https://cloud.google.com/solutions/sql-server-multi-regional-disaster-recovery
[5] Cost of IT Downtime and Enterprise Availability Benchmarks (Gartner, 2021) https://www.gartner.com/en/information-technology

items.title: Four operational scenarios covered by runbooks
points: Unplanned zone failure: verify automatic Zone B promotion and triage WSFC alerts
Regional disaster: run forced failover script on Region 2 asynchronous replica
Quorum exhaustion: stop cluster service and force quorum start on surviving node
Planned OS patching: drain secondary, patch, perform manual zero-loss failover, repeat

items.title: Deterministic recovery execution
points: Scenario 1 validates automatic intra-region HA. Scenario 2 promotes the Region 2 node via FORCE_FAILOVER_ALLOW_DATA_LOSS when Region 1 is unreachable. Scenario 3 restores WSFC voting via FixQuorum. Scenario 4 sequences rolling Windows Server updates across zones without dropping clinical transactions.
